context: M6 o5c. W 38th St. Lonnie's boys are on the pavement. Delphine counts the envelope.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Rule three: when they see you, you're already gone. Three and a half: unless they grab.

lines.speaker: char.tina_mercado
lines.text: Del. You cut his sleeve off. His whole sleeve.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Ninety-five dollars. All there. Walk with me to the Pennsylvania, Tina.
